cefr_and_length.evidence: Batch02 spans A1-C2 with 4-9 segments; Batch03 demonstrates 4, 6 and 10 segments through Generic Practice runtime.
cefr_and_length.acceptance: No semantic issue from level or segment count alone. Lesson must fit an existing Practice operator/evidence model and pass normal grounding.

interaction_structures.evidence: Existing runtime supports task rows, sequence/full-context playback and context-preserving mixed/full-panel behavior; wrapper selects by represented capability, not batch/lesson identity.
interaction_structures.acceptance: Existing descriptor/presentation shapes only. A genuinely new interaction contract is a novelty trigger.

natural_spoken_english.evidence: Batch01-03 exact realization QA uses ordinary automated lexical/container checks plus bounded realization-specific evidence where construct requires it; Product direction accepts residual accent uncertainty.
natural_spoken_english.acceptance: Intelligibility and exact semantic realization must be sufficient for the intended Practice construct; no certification perfection requirement.

answer_feedback.evidence: Batch03 retained correct and incorrect learner outcomes, response/evidence rows, separate dictation and exact-context feedback ACKs; negative first-pass is not recorded as success.
answer_feedback.acceptance: Correct answer/reference answer must remain grounded to final anchors; support/replay must be reflected in evidence strength.

audio_text_binding.evidence: Exact lesson/version/realization/segment/hash binding is enforced by descriptors, resume identity and live receipts; changed hashes and stale versions are rejected.
audio_text_binding.acceptance: Every playable asset must bind deterministically to stable segment IDs and realization version; mixed context must preserve canonical mapping.

vietnamese_support.evidence: Batch02 support QA reviewed 77 exact English/vi-VN segment pairs; targeted Vietnamese-only repair did not change English lesson or Practice semantics. Batch03 support hashes were exact-bound and live verified.
vietnamese_support.acceptance: Full segment coverage, semantic fidelity, natural Vietnamese, exact lesson/version reference; support remains assistance rather than Practice evidence.

review_progression.evidence: Support state, replay count, evidence strength, repair-only evidence and no-transfer-mastery claims are carried in Batch02/03 Practice rows. Resume round trips and rejection cases are covered by Generic Practice integration tests.
review_progression.acceptance: Repair/retention/transfer distinctions remain frozen. No single assisted success may be promoted to generalized mastery.

desktop_mobile_continuity.evidence: Batch02 12/12 and Batch03 3/3 exact releases passed desktop and Chromium Pixel5 emulation; Batch03 resume and withdrawal revalidation covered both modes.
desktop_mobile_continuity.acceptance: Continue exact-pair staging/live checks for materially changed runtime behavior. No physical iOS/Android claim is inferred from emulation.

legacy_ownership.evidence: Generic wrapper explicitly leaves legacy envelopes to legacy runtimes; tests verify generic restore does not consume/delete legacy-owned envelopes and navigation/rollback preserve original function identities.
legacy_ownership.acceptance: No migration/retirement is implied. Any change to legacy ownership is a separate authorized compatibility decision.

pr156_assessment.defect: Withdrawal-only race: immediate catalog navigation could cancel restoration before stale generic resume-envelope cleanup after asynchronous catalog load.
pr156_assessment.semantic_scope: Generic resume/withdrawal lifecycle cleanup only; no scoring, target grounding, support semantics, audio binding or legacy ownership semantics changed.
pr156_assessment.correction: Cleanup of withdrawn generic envelopes occurs after successful catalog loading even when navigation cancels restoration; disposal and legacy ownership protections remain.
regression_evidence: Unit regression reproduces delayed catalog load + immediate navigation and requires stale generic envelope deletion with no reopening.

Generic wrapper test suite retains differential presentation/events/history/audio coverage, resume round trips and rejection cases, unseen shape-driven identity behavior, stale hash/version rejection and legacy ownership checks.
PR #156 revalidated only the invalidated withdrawal gate while reusing retained read-only receipts for unaffected core learner outcomes.
Six staging and six live desktop/mobile withdrawal checks PASS after protected exact-head merge/deployment.
No synthesis, feedback writes or full playback rerun was needed for the corrected gate.
pr156_assessment.rationale: The failure was reproducible under a specific asynchronous withdrawal/navigation ordering, fixed at the cleanup boundary, and the targeted correction passed while unaffected core outcomes were preserved by hash-bound receipts. No evidence shows generalized state corruption, scoring drift, audio/text mismatch or legacy ownership break.

fully_reusable_gates: construct-aware Practice mapping using existing operators
short-span dictation with orthography separated from auditory evidence
realization-dependent cue validation only where the construct requires it
feedback ACK smoke verification under existing capability
novelty_triggers_requiring_new_semantic_: A Practice construct/operator/response format not represented by Practice Production Specification v0.1
A new evidence dimension or learner-state claim beyond the existing model
A new support mode whose effect on evidence strength is not already defined
A new transfer/generalization claim, especially calibrated mastery or unseen-transfer certification
A new interaction structure that cannot normalize into existing task-row, sequence/full-context or context-preserving mixed/full-panel descriptors
A new mixed/overlap behavior that breaks stable segment/context mapping or existing evidence-condition semantics
A requirement to make transcript exposure, hinting or replay count as stronger evidence than frozen semantics permit
A proposal to migrate/retire legacy resume ownership or merge legacy and Generic state
A scoring requirement based on fine phonetic/prosodic/accent certification rather than bounded learner-outcome evidence
A learner-support locale behavior that changes Curriculum target meaning or Practice scoring rather than remaining support
minimum_sufficient_acceptance_for_six_le: All six lesson identities pass Curriculum/Unique Purpose and existing preproduction gates; no duplicate/open conflict.
Each lesson's final produced target_anchors[] maps to existing Practice v0.1 behavior without invented Curriculum semantics.
Each Practice question/choice/reference answer is proposition-grounded and has exactly one defensible scoring key for its construct.
Any short-span task uses stable segment/span grounding and separates orthographic normalization from auditory evidence.
Audio is intelligible and exact-bound to lesson/version/realization/segment hashes; only construct-relevant realization cues require additional bounded evidence.
vi-VN support has complete segment coverage and semantic QA; support text does not become Curriculum truth or scoring evidence.
Support, replay, transcript exposure and playback rate are logged and evidence strength is downgraded according to frozen semantics.
Resume restores only exact compatible Generic envelopes; stale version/hash/identity/age/route envelopes fail closed.
Withdrawn Generic lessons clear their stale Generic resume envelope even under immediate navigation; no reopen after cancellation.
Legacy-owned envelopes remain untouched by Generic cleanup.
Desktop and mobile-emulation learner flows pass for materially changed or newly represented runtime paths; unchanged generic runtime gates may be reused rather than rerun globally.
Rollback/withdrawal remains per-lesson and does not revive stale state.
Final PRACTICE_READY and CONTRACT_VALID are exact-pair decisions; no generalized mastery or calibration claim is inferred.

known_risks_and_mitigations.mitigation: Retain PR#156 regression and targeted withdrawal/live gate whenever resume/withdrawal lifecycle code changes. Do not rerun full playback when only this gate is invalidated.

known_risks_and_mitigations.risk: Physical-device differences not covered by Pixel5 emulation
known_risks_and_mitigations.mitigation: Do not claim physical iOS/Android coverage. Escalate only if a learner-facing physical-device defect or browser-specific behavior is evidenced.
Use minimum sufficient exact-realization evidence only when the Practice construct depends on the cue; do not reopen general audio research or require human certification.
Keep ownership split and rollback/reference path. Reopen only if evidence shows cross-owner corruption or an authorized retirement/migration objective.

compatibility_io_decoupling.reason: No current learner-facing evidence shows that Generic Practice's descriptor/core boundary or IO/legacy split is insufficient. Batch02/03 production and live evidence show shape-driven reuse across varied lessons; PR#156 was repaired inside the existing lifecycle boundary.

r1_4.reason: No unresolved semantic or learner-facing risk requires R1.4. Existing runtime plus bounded regression gates covers the demonstrated defect class.

technical_surgery.reason: No redesign or compatibility surgery is supported by current evidence. The minimum mitigation is to preserve existing regression/withdrawal checks and trigger new semantic review only on explicit novelty conditions.

recommended_next_step: If Owner later authorizes Batch04 execution, admit the proposed six lessons through the existing Curriculum→Practice preproduction gates, compare their characteristics against the novelty-trigger list above, and use the current Generic Practice production/runtime path unchanged for routine cases. Do not open Batch04 in this review.
